Widely Applicable Information Criterion (WAIC)

Source: R/qaic.R
WAIC.Rd

Computes the Watanabe-Akaike (Widely Applicable) Information Criterion (WAIC; Watanabe 2010; Gelman, Hwang & Vehtari 2014) from the full pointwise posterior log-likelihood draws of Bayesian MCMC doas models (method = "Bayes"). Can compare both detection covariate models (p_formula = ~ ...), abundance covariate models (n_formula = ~ ...), and the null model.

Evaluates the log pointwise predictive density (lppd) and the effective number of parameters (p_WAIC, computed via the posterior variance of the pointwise log-likelihood across MCMC draws as recommended by Gelman et al. 2014).

Usage

WAIC(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'doas'
WAIC(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A fitted `doas` object with method = "Bayes" (or "bayesian").

...

Optionally more fitted Bayesian `doas` objects.

Value

If a single model is provided, a numeric scalar WAIC value (with attributes lppd, p_WAIC, and SE). If multiple models are provided, a sorted comparison data frame with columns lppd, p_WAIC, WAIC, SE, and delta_WAIC.

A numeric WAIC value (for a single model) or a comparison data frame (for multiple models).
